entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The military arm of Alta Torrezon, a vampire praetorian force of conquistadors, formed as the order of Saint Elenda.

entities.name: Alta Torrezon
entities.description: An ecclesiastic vampire monarchy on the continent of Torrezon on Ixalan, once a small mountain city-state.

entities.name: Church of Dusk
entities.description: The powerful church allied with Queen Miralda to form the Legion of Dusk.

entities.name: Queen Miralda
entities.description: The iron-fisted vampire monarch of Alta Torrezon.

entities.name: Elenda
entities.description: A custodian of the Immortal Sun who became the first vampire and gave the Rite of Redemption to Alta Torrezon, later sentinel of the Golden City.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: A sphinx planeswalker who put the Immortal Sun in Alta Torrezon's care and later reclaimed it.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An object of religious reverence stolen from Alta Torrezon and later brought to Ixalan.

entities.name: Pedron the Wicked
entities.description: A rival king who stole the Immortal Sun from the monastery but lost it to Azor.

entities.name: Vona de Iedo
entities.description: A Legion leader who questions Elenda, and now guides the radical faction and separatists.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: A vampire who punished Vona, was captured by the Sun Empire, and is now the pontifex directing the church orthodoxy.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: An extremist who infiltrated the Queen's Bay Company and freed Aclazotz.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: A bat god bound in Ixalan's Core, freed by Vito, who escapes to Torrezon seeking Vona.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A Sun Empire planeswalker who kills Vito with his own lance.

entities.name: Queen's Bay Company
entities.description: A commercial venture created by the Legion for Torrezon's expeditions to Ixalan, infiltrated by extremists.

entities.name: Apostasine princes
entities.description: The two brothers who declared themselves apostasine princes and waged civil war on their sister and the church.

entities.name: Rite of Redemption
entities.description: The ritual blessing of the chosen with vampirism begun by Elenda.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane of Torrezon, the Sun Empire and the River Heralds.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The human empire that repelled the Legion and allied with captured vampires against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that interrupted the Legion-Sun Empire war and left Torrezon in famine.

entities.name: Apostasine Wars
entities.description: The long civil war of Alta Torrezon, beginning in 803 BD.

events.summary: The Immortal Sun is placed in Alta Torrezon's care by Azor, then stolen by Pedron the Wicked who loses it to Azor.
events.quote: The monastery fell under attack by the forces of the rival king Pedron the Wicked who stole the Immortal Sun but in turn, lost it to Azor.

events.summary: The monarch's death splits the kingdom and Alta Torrezon explodes into civil war in 803 BD.
events.quote: Alta Torrezon exploded into civil war.

events.summary: The civil war rages for two hundred and fifty years before a mutual cessation of hostilities.
events.quote: The civil war raged on for two hundred and fifty years, with the children of all three rulers carrying on the conflict.

events.summary: In 495 BD a stranger wreathed in black vapor routs the apostasine princes' army outside Alta Torrezon.
events.quote: wreathed in rippling black vapor, this rider charged into the honor guard of the apostate princes, slaughtering all in her path

events.summary: Elenda gives the gift of vampirism to Alta Torrezon's loyalist nobility, founding the Rite of Redemption.
events.quote: This ritualistic blessing of the chosen with vampirism became known as the Rite of Redemption.

events.summary: A vast undead army calling itself the Legion of Dusk marches from Alta Torrezon on a campaign of conquest.
events.quote: They called themselves the Legion of Dusk .

events.summary: The last independent city-states of the southern coast fall, sending refugees fleeing across the sea.
events.quote: the few remaining independent city-states on the continent's southern coast would fall to the Legion's armies

events.summary: Elenda tells her followers that immortality was not the purpose of her gift but protection, and that she will be sentinel of the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Elenda answered that immortality was not the purpose of her gift, but protection.

events.summary: Mavren Fein punishes Vona for speaking ill of the living saint.
events.quote: Vona denied her, but Mavren Fein punished Vona for speaking ill of the living saint.

events.summary: The Sun Empire repels the Legion's attempted conquest.
events.quote: The Legion's attempted conquest of the continent was repelled by the Sun Empire.

events.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion forces captured vampires to join the Sun Empire against it.
events.quote: However, before the war could continue, the New Phyrexian Invasion started, and the captured Mavren Fein's vampires had to join with the Sun Empire to defend the plane.

events.summary: Torrezon splits between orthodoxy under Mavren Fein and radicals under Vona.
events.quote: The church orthodoxy is directed by Pontifex Mavren Fein.

events.summary: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte frees Aclazotz in Ixalan's Core and he and his followers become batlike demons.
events.quote: the bat god bestowed his blessing on Vito and his followers, turning them into batlike demons .

events.summary: Huatli summons dinosaurs and kills Vito with his own lance.
events.quote: Huatli summoned a horde of dinosaurs and killed Vito with his own lance.

events.summary: Aclazotz escapes on a Dusk Legion ship bound for Torrezon to find Vona.
events.quote: Aclazotz escaped, securing passage to Torrezon on a Dusk Legion ship.

relations.note: iron-fisted monarch allied with the church
relations.quote: The Legion of Dusk is an alliance between the powerful Church of Dusk and the iron-fisted monarch Queen Miralda .

relations.quote: Aligned against her rule are myriad separatists organized under Vona.

relations.quote: Queen Miralda is de facto aligned with the pontifex and the church orthodoxy.

relations.quote: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte broke his bindings.
